// ============================================================================

// Sneak → Flurry - Sequencer (Pipeline Version + PSEUDO caster step / step back)

// - Pseudo movement uses ONE continuous session (no snap)

// - Adds easing (easeInOutCubic)

// ============================================================================

(async () => {

const TAG = "[SneakFlurry]";

try {

if (!game.modules.get("sequencer")?.active) {

ui.notifications.error("Sequencer module is not active.");

return;

}

// Minimal ONI.emit helper (same pattern)

globalThis.ONI = globalThis.ONI ?? {};

if (!ONI.emit) {

ONI.emit = function (eventName, payload = {}, options = {}) {

const { local = true, world = false } = options;

if (local) Hooks.callAll(eventName, payload);

if (world) game.socket.emit("world", { action: eventName, payload });

};

}

// --- Payload ---

const payload = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

// --- Helpers ---

const isUuid = (v) => typeof v === "string" && v.includes(".");

async function resolveToken(ref) {

if (!ref) return null;

if (ref?.document && ref?.object) return ref;

if (ref?.id && canvas.tokens?.get(ref.id)) return canvas.tokens.get(ref.id);

if (isUuid(ref)) {

const doc = await fromUuid(ref);

if (!doc) return null;

if (doc.object) return doc.object;

if (doc.document?.object) return doc.document.object;

return null;

}

if (typeof ref === "string") return canvas.tokens.get(ref) ?? null;

return null;

}

function pickTargetsFromPayload(p) {

if (Array.isArray(p.targetTokenIds) && p.targetTokenIds.length) return p.targetTokenIds;

if (Array.isArray(p.targets) && p.targets.length) {

const out = [];

for (const t of p.targets) {

if (typeof t === "string") out.push(t);

else if (t?.tokenId) out.push(t.tokenId);

else if (t?.tokenUuid) out.push(t.tokenUuid);

}

return out.filter(Boolean);

}

if (Array.isArray(p.rows)) {

const out = [];

for (const r of p.rows) {

if (r?.targetTokenId) out.push(r.targetTokenId);

if (r?.targetTokenUuid) out.push(r.targetTokenUuid);

}

if (out.length) return out;

}

return [];

}

// --- Resolve caster & targets from pipeline ---

const sourceRef =

payload.sourceTokenUuid ??

payload.sourceTokenId ??

payload.casterTokenUuid ??

payload.casterTokenId ??

payload.attackerTokenUuid ??

payload.attackerTokenId ??

null;

const targetRefs = pickTargetsFromPayload(payload);

// Fallbacks for quick testing

const fallbackSource = canvas.tokens.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

const fallbackTargets = Array.from(game.user.targets ?? []);

const sourceToken = (await resolveToken(sourceRef)) ?? fallbackSource;

const targets = [];

for (const r of targetRefs) {

const tok = await resolveToken(r);

if (tok) targets.push(tok);

}

if (!targets.length && fallbackTargets.length) targets.push(...fallbackTargets);

if (!sourceToken) {

ui.notifications.warn("SneakFlurry: No caster token (payload missing and nothing selected).");

return;

}

if (!targets.length) {

ui.notifications.warn("SneakFlurry: No targets (payload missing and nothing targeted).");

return;

}

const targetToken = targets[0];

// --- TARGET disposition (for side + flip) ---

const targetDisposition =

targetToken?._token?.actor?.document?.disposition ??

targetToken?.actor?.document?.disposition ??

targetToken?.document?.disposition ??

0;

const targetHostile = targetDisposition === -1;

const SIDE_OFFSET_PX = 140;

const sideOffsetX = targetHostile ? SIDE_OFFSET_PX : -SIDE_OFFSET_PX;

const mirrorX = targetHostile;

// --- CASTER disposition (for step movement) ---

const casterDisposition =

sourceToken?.actor?.document?.disposition ??

sourceToken?.document?.disposition ??

0;

const casterMoveRight = casterDisposition === -1;

// --- Caster step distance (X-only) ---

const squares = 0.35;

const offsetPx = canvas.grid.size * squares;

const dx = casterMoveRight ? +offsetPx : -offsetPx;

// --- Assets ---

const FX_1 =

"modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/1st_Level/Sneak_Attack/Sneak_Attack_Dark_Green_300x300.webm";

const FX_2 =

"modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Unarmed_Attacks/Flurry_Of_Blows/FlurryOfBlows_01_Regular_Blue_Magical01_800x600.webm";

const SFX_MOVE = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Beginspell.mp3";

const SFX_1 = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Beginspell.mp3";

const SFX_2 =

"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Damage3.ogg";

// --- Broadcast start ---

ONI.emit(

"oni:animationStart",

{

type: "sneakFlurry",

sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,

targetTokenIds: [targetToken.id],

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now(),

},

{ local: true, world: false }

);

// --- Timing constants (match your original sequence timing) ---

const MOVE_DURATION = 350;

const WAIT_AFTER_STEP_OUT = 150;

const WAIT_BETWEEN_FX = 1500;

const WAIT_BEFORE_STEP_BACK = 150;

// Total "hold forward" time inside pseudo session:

// after move-out finishes, we previously waited 150, then ran VFX timeline (1500), then waited 150 before moving back

const HOLD_FORWARD_MS = WAIT_AFTER_STEP_OUT + WAIT_BETWEEN_FX + WAIT_BEFORE_STEP_BACK;

// --- Pseudo availability ---

const hasPseudo = !!game.ONI?.pseudo?.play;

// --- MAIN ---

if (!hasPseudo) {

// ===== Fallback (your old real-token movement) =====

const original = { x: sourceToken.document.x, y: sourceToken.document.y };

const destOut = { x: original.x + dx, y: original.y };

const destBack = { x: original.x, y: original.y };

const seq = new Sequence();

seq.sound().file(SFX_MOVE).volume(0.9);

seq.animation().on(sourceToken).moveTowards(destOut).duration(MOVE_DURATION).waitUntilFinished();

seq.wait(WAIT_AFTER_STEP_OUT);

seq.effect()

.file(FX_1)

.atLocation(targetToken, { offset: { x: sideOffsetX, y: 0 } })

.scale(1.2)

.mirrorX(mirrorX)

.fadeIn(150)

.fadeOut(200);

seq.sound().file(SFX_1).volume(0.8);

seq.wait(WAIT_BETWEEN_FX);

seq.effect()

.file(FX_2)

.atLocation(targetToken)

.scale(1.0)

.mirrorX(mirrorX)

.fadeIn(100)

.fadeOut(200);

seq.sound().file(SFX_2).volume(0.8);

seq.wait(WAIT_BEFORE_STEP_BACK);

seq.animation().on(sourceToken).moveTowards(destBack).duration(MOVE_DURATION).waitUntilFinished();

await seq.play();

if (sourceToken.document.x !== original.x || sourceToken.document.y !== original.y) {

await sourceToken.document.update({ x: original.x, y: original.y });

}

} else {

// ===== Pseudo path (NO SNAP): one continuous session =====

// 1) Start pseudo movement session (does: hide real -> clone -> ease move out -> hold -> ease move back -> unhide)

const pseudoScriptSource = `

const { casterToken, params } = ctx;

if (!casterToken) throw new Error("SneakFlurryPseudo: casterToken missing");

const dx = Number(params.dx ?? 0);

const dur = Number(params.dur ?? 300);

const hold = Number(params.hold ?? 0);

// Easing: easeInOutCubic

function easeInOutCubic(t) {

return t < 0.5 ? 4*t*t*t : 1 - Math.pow(-2*t + 2, 3)/2;

}

function animate(obj, fromX, fromY, toX, toY, durMs) {

return new Promise(resolve => {

const startTime = performance.now();

const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

const update = () => {

const raw = (performance.now() - startTime) / durMs;

const t = Math.min(Math.max(raw, 0), 1);

const e = easeInOutCubic(t);

obj.x = fromX + (toX - fromX) * e;

obj.y = fromY + (toY - fromY) * e;

if (t >= 1) { ticker.remove(update); resolve(); }

};

ticker.add(update);

});

}

async function createClone(token) {

const baseObj = token.mesh ?? token.icon;

const texture = baseObj?.texture ?? await loadTexture(token.document.texture.src);

const sprite = new PIXI.Sprite(texture);

sprite.anchor.set(0.5);

sprite.x = token.center.x;

sprite.y = token.center.y;

if (baseObj) { sprite.width = baseObj.width; sprite.height = baseObj.height; }

sprite.zIndex = 5000;

canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true;

canvas.stage.addChild(sprite);

canvas.stage.sortChildren();

return sprite;

}

const baseMesh = casterToken.mesh ?? casterToken.icon;

// IMPORTANT: keep real token hidden for the entire session (no re-show between moves)

const originalTokenVisible = casterToken.visible;

const originalMeshVisible = baseMesh?.visible ?? true;

let sprite;

try {

sprite = await createClone(casterToken);

// Hide real token visuals (local only)

if (baseMesh) baseMesh.visible = false;

casterToken.visible = false;

// Move out (ease)

const startX = sprite.x;

const startY = sprite.y;

const outX = startX + dx;

const outY = startY;

await animate(sprite, startX, startY, outX, outY, dur);

// Hold forward position while VFX plays

if (hold > 0) await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, hold));

// Move back (ease)

await animate(sprite, outX, outY, startX, startY, dur);

} finally {

if (sprite) {

canvas.stage.removeChild(sprite);

sprite.destroy();

}

// Unhide real token only AFTER clone is back + destroyed

if (baseMesh) baseMesh.visible = originalMeshVisible;

casterToken.visible = originalTokenVisible;

}

`;

// Kick the pseudo session (movement + hold + return)

game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: "sneakFlurry.pseudoSession",

scriptSource: pseudoScriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken.document.uuid,

targetTokenUuids: [],

params: { dx, dur: MOVE_DURATION, hold: HOLD_FORWARD_MS },

meta: { source: "SneakFlurry" },

});

// 2) Play move sound right away (feels like “step out starts now”)

new Sequence().sound().file(SFX_MOVE).volume(0.9).play();

// 3) Run VFX timeline while pseudo is holding forward (timed to match)

// Wait exactly like original: 150 after step-out finishes

await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, MOVE_DURATION + WAIT_AFTER_STEP_OUT));

const fxSeq = new Sequence();

fxSeq.effect()

.file(FX_1)

.atLocation(targetToken, { offset: { x: sideOffsetX, y: 0 } })

.scale(1.2)

.mirrorX(mirrorX)

.fadeIn(150)

.fadeOut(200);

fxSeq.sound().file(SFX_1).volume(0.8);

fxSeq.wait(WAIT_BETWEEN_FX);

fxSeq.effect()

.file(FX_2)

.atLocation(targetToken)

.scale(1.0)

.mirrorX(mirrorX)

.fadeIn(100)

.fadeOut(200);

fxSeq.sound().file(SFX_2).volume(0.8);

await fxSeq.play();

// Note: pseudo script will automatically start moving back after HOLD_FORWARD_MS

// We just wait long enough for the pseudo session to finish so end-event timing feels right.

const pseudoTotalMs = MOVE_DURATION + HOLD_FORWARD_MS + MOVE_DURATION;

await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, Math.max(0, pseudoTotalMs - (MOVE_DURATION + WAIT_AFTER_STEP_OUT)) + 30));

}

// --- Broadcast end ---

ONI.emit(

"oni:animationEnd",

{

type: "sneakFlurry",

sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,

targetTokenIds: [targetToken.id],

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now(),

},

{ local: true, world: false }

);

console.log(TAG, "END");

} catch (err) {

console.error(`${TAG} Animation crashed:`, err);

try {

globalThis.ONI?.emit?.(

"oni:animationEnd",

{ type: "sneakFlurry", error: true, timestamp: Date.now() },

{ local: true }

);

} catch (_) {}

}

})();
